subject: math
description: Determine whether three side lengths can form a triangle and find possible ranges for a missing side length.
learningObjectives: State the triangle inequality rule for three side lengths
Determine whether three given lengths can form a triangle
Explain why equality is not enough to form a triangle
Find the possible range for a missing side using the difference and sum of the other two sides
Represent missing side ranges with inequalities and number-line diagrams
prerequisites: Use inequality symbols such as < and >
Recognize that a triangle is a closed three-sided figure
